|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Solomahal (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on your scout (except Luke). If opponent targets this character (or ship he is aboard) with a weapon, you may place Solomahal in Lost Pile to cancel that targeting.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on your scout (except Luke). If scout (or starship they are aboard) was just targeted by a weapon, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel that targeting.” '''What changed:''' “opponent targets this character” → “scout”; “ship he is” → “starship they are”; “with” → “was just targeted by”; removed “you”; “Solomahal” → “this Effect”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 21. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Solomahal]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Solomahal (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Solomahal]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_21.
